plugins.name: structured-prompt-engineering
plugins.description: Pattern for writing getSystemPrompt/getUserPromptTemplate as JSON.stringify objects — structure, parameterization, and do's/don'ts

plugins.name: biome-lint-setup
plugins.description: Lint/format setup with Biome translated from the ESLint + Prettier + simple-import-sort + tailwindcss standard, with .editorconfig and a Node version pin (mise or .nvmrc) — monorepo-aware; Next.js, Vite, and Node backends (Hono, Fastify, Express, NestJS)

plugins.name: folder-structure-standard
plugins.description: Folder layout and layering (model/service/controller/infra) for Next.js full-stack, Vite/React SPA, Node backends (Hono, Fastify, Express), and pnpm monorepos combining them

plugins.name: mcp-server-architecture
plugins.description: Folder layout and layering for TypeScript MCP servers — single-domain (flat, Anthropic mcp-builder style) vs multi-domain modular monolith (domain/application/infrastructure per module), SOLID applied to tool registration, factory + composition root to avoid prop-drilling, Zod as the single source of truth for input/output schemas, and publishing the server privately via a self-hosted Verdaccio npm registry

plugins.name: requirements-ux-analyst
plugins.description: Subagent that analyzes raw business requirements and extracts hidden scenarios, unhappy paths, edge cases, required UI states (loading/empty/error), security flaws, and conflicting business rules, draws the full flow as a Mermaid flowchart, and keeps a versioned Markdown history of every analysis — actionable output for frontend developers
